DEzeno is a design & build firm rooted in Desa ParkCity, Kuala Lumpur. We handle everything in-house — concept, carpentry, and construction — so your renovation runs smoothly from day one to handover.
Whether you're renovating a landed home in Desa ParkCity, a condominium in Mont Kiara, or a shophouse in Kepong, our team brings design, precision and care to every space across the Klang Valley.

What We Do
Full-Scope Renovation Services
From concept to handover — one team, one quote, zero stress.
01
Interior Design
Full space planning, mood boards, 3D visualisation, and material selection tailored to your lifestyle and budget.
ResidentialCondoBungalow
02
Renovation & Build
Full gut renovation, structural works, plumbing, electrical, plastering, tiling — all under one roof with one project manager.
Turn-Key Solution
03
Custom Design Carpentry
Wardrobes, kitchen cabinets and built-ins, precision-made and on-site installed — finished with family-safe materials.
Custom Built-Ins
04
Commercial & Office
Retail fit-outs, office renovations, and commercial spaces designed for productivity, brand identity, and footfall.
OfficeRetailF&B
05
Landed Property
Bungalows, semi-Ds, and terraced houses. We handle the complexity of landed renovations including structural extension works.
BungalowSemi-DTerrace
06
Smart Home Integration
Aqara, smart lighting, automated curtains, and energy-saving systems seamlessly woven into your renovation plan.
AqaraSmart Lighting
Discuss Your Project →
Our Commitment
Built on Trust, Delivered with Care
At DEzeno, we believe a renovation should feel exciting, not stressful. We engineer our entire process — from quoting to handover — around clarity, craftsmanship, and creating spaces people love to live in.
Beautiful & Functional
Design that looks stunning and works for how you actually live.
Precise Detailing
Every millimetre matters. Craftsmen trained to hotel-standard tolerances.
Healthy Space
Family-safe materials, so your space is safe for pets, kids, preggies and elders.
Transparent Process
Fixed-price quotes, weekly WhatsApp updates, site visits welcome anytime.
